reasons.orphan|figure.study-art: The study plate is a marginal illustration: it stands at the top of the intro row, beside the title and the opening line, and the item beside it is the taller of the two — the plate fills between a third and a half of the row it stands in. The space under the plate is therefore the height of the title next to it, not a hole. The plate is a picture in the margin, not a picture in the text — the reading column is not shortened to make room for it, because the reading column is what the page is for.
reasons.orphan|figure.hero-art: At 721px, 722px and 768px — the widths where the app grid's rail has come back and the reading column is narrow — the home page and the learn page stand the hero plate BESIDE the title. The plate is 180px tall at each of those widths and fills 47% of a row 384px tall, so the title column is much the taller of the two and the space beside the plate is the title's own height. The plate is set in the margin of the title; the title is not shortened to make room for it.
reasons.orphan|figure.tikki-hero-art: On /tikki/ the drawing of Tikki is the illustration of that page, and it stands beside the title in the same row every hero plate stands in. It is the shorter of the two — 216px to 258px tall across these widths, filling 29% to 44% of the row it stands in — so the space under the drawing is the title's own height. The drawing is set in the margin of the title, and the title is not shortened to make room for it.
reasons.dead|div.intro-text: The intro row is as tall as the drawing beside it — the drawing is the taller of the two, at 312px at the narrow end of this range and 340px at the wide end — so on the pages whose opening is a single sentence the reading column under that sentence is empty. That space is the break before the next section, which begins below the drawing. The drawing is sized by the house, and the paragraph under it is the first thing read.
reasons.dead|figcaption: The caption is the label of a picture, and it stands beside it: the caption is centred against the picture, so the empty space above the caption and the empty space below it are the same size, and together with the caption they make up the height of the picture. It is a label attached to a picture, not a paragraph in a column of its own.
reasons.dead|p.law-text: The statute is followed by a margin note — a second thing, not a continuation of the article. The space above the note is what makes the note read as an annotation of the article rather than as more of the article, and the note is an annotation at every width the gate measures.
reasons.dead|div.route-number.mono: The number column is a timeline. The numbers are joined by a hairline that runs down the column, and each number sits at the TOP of its row so the line joins number to number. The space below each number is the runway that line occupies; the marker is a point on the line, not a label centred in a cell.
reasons.dead|div.anchor-features.mono: At 721px and 722px, where the rail comes back and squeezes the reading column, the three figures on the home page and the learn page — how many sections, how many scripts, how many highlighters — are a marginal note set off by a rule from the pitch beside them, not a third column of the same thing. The pitch runs longer than the note, so the note ends first and the rule ends with it. The space under the note is the rest of the margin.

exempt.why: The drill's front door is the last thing in the block on purpose: the promise, the method in two lines, and the caveat that this is not an official paper all come before the commitment, because a reader should know what the drill is and what it is not before they start it. It costs 19px of scrolling on a 390-wide phone, and 27px at 721px and 722px, where the rail comes back and squeezes the reading column to 433px so those three lines wrap further. The 844px bound is a phone's fold; at 721px the screen is 1000px tall and the button is still above the fold of the screen it is on. The same decision, so it is written down once.
